findings.summary: The geolocation error dialog is a div shown by clearing hidden, not a dialog opened with showModal(), and the page behind it is never inert.
findings.fix: Use a dialog element with no role or aria-modal, and open it with showModal() so it enters the top layer and the browser marks the rest of the page inert. On the home page this div sits inside .home-hero .inner (z-10), so the z-50 header stays clickable above it.
findings.evidence: <div class="app-dialog" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" hidden> is shown with element.hidden = false. body.dialog-open only sets overflow:hidden. No inert.

findings.summary: Home locate disables its button before the error dialog opens, so close restores focus to the body instead of that button.
findings.fix: Keep the locate button enabled until the dialog opens, or store that button and focus it from close() for Escape, Close, OK, and the backdrop. setLocateBusy(false) re-enables the button without moving focus back to it.
findings.evidence: setLocateBusy(true) sets locateButton.disabled before getCurrentPosition. show() then stores document.activeElement, which is no longer the button.

passed: Geolocation dialog keydown handler closes on Escape.
Geolocation dialog keydown handler wraps Tab and Shift+Tab between the Close and OK buttons.
Geolocation dialog name comes from aria-labelledby on its h2.
Geolocation dialog has a visible Close button with aria-label, and its icon is aria-hidden.
Initial focus moves to the OK button, the acknowledgment action.
aria-describedby points at one short plain-text paragraph.
Locate triggers on the home page and the map are button elements.
The dialog heading is an h2.
No in-scope dialog element is opened with the open attribute or HTMLDialogElement.show().
The home and map error dialogs are not nested.
notes: Mobile primary navigation in app/components/navigation/bar_component.html.erb is an in-flow disclosure. Modal focus-trap, inert, and showModal checks do not apply. Escape closes it and focus returns to the menu button.

Map mobile search in app/views/maps/show.html.erb covers the map and leaves the header operable, so it is an overlay sheet rather than a modal. Escape closes it. Focus moves to the search field and is not returned to the search toggle.
The map settings panel is an anchored disclosure with aria-expanded. Page content stays operable. Escape closes it. Opening it does not move focus.
The map legend is a native details disclosure. Modal checks do not apply.
Home and map station suggestions are combobox listboxes. On the home page, Escape hides the list and returns focus to the input.
FAQ answers are accordion disclosures. Modal checks do not apply.
Leaflet marker popups on /map are non-modal. Escape calls map.closePopup(). They are not dialog elements.
The county or region jump on /gauges/wa and /alerts is a details disclosure. Modal checks do not apply.

app/views/layouts/application.html.erb contains no dialog, popover, drawer, overlay, or aria-modal. Each in-scope page renders Navigation::BarComponent itself. Alerts, about, contact, subscriptions, privacy, terms, disclosures, and aup templates have no modal.

No popover attribute appears in the reviewed templates. Screen-reader announcement of the geolocation dialog was not runtime-checked. On /map the locate button stays enabled, so focus return can succeed when that button still has focus; the browser permission UI was not runtime-checked.
